title: No startup log for cert path, loaded vs. generated
description: load_or_generate_cert() in tls.rs is completely silent. On startup, no log line records: which cert file was loaded, whether it was freshly generated or loaded from disk, or when it expires. When clients cannot connect due to an expired cert, the operator has no log evidence of what cert was ever active. Fix: add tracing::info\! in both branches of load_or_generate_cert: 'generated new self-signed cert at {cert_path}' and 'loaded TLS cert from {cert_path}'. Bonus: log the not-before/not-after if parseable.
